governance_bootstrap.summary: Completion reporting requires real verification evidence, completion guard evidence, and exact file/test/deploy state.
Origin/main is the source of truth; production changes require commit, push, deploy_to_macmini, and real entrypoint verification.

codex_cli_rule: Codex CLI uses caveman ultra by default unless explicitly disabled; code change summaries must keep changed files, verification, commit, and deploy state exact.
problem: OpenClaw reported two harness_saju_query timeout failures and could not return today's Saju fortune.
root_cause: The JS harness_saju_query wrapper had the same 300s wall-clock timeout as the Python bridge request timeout, while the Python path can spend time on status/source verification, cache lock waiting, and nlm helper timeout margins.
The Python query timeout was applied mainly to the nlm call, not to the whole cache-lock plus query budget.
OpenClaw tool error output hid the actionable timeout reason.
changes: scripts/openclaw_codex_bridge.py: bound cache lock waiting and nlm query timeout to the overall query budget.
plugins/harness-bridge/index.js: give JS wrapper a 30s margin over the Python query budget.
plugins/harness-bridge/index.js: return sanitized reason codes instead of raw system error details.
tests/test_openclaw_saju_bridge_timeout.py: add regression coverage for lock contention, OSError cleanup, budget exhaustion, and lock release.
core/saju_calendar.py: when OpenClaw sends a stale explicit target date plus Korean relative today, treat today as the authoritative KST target date instead of creating a third date.
core/saju_calendar.py: accept unambiguous 오전/오후/AM/PM birth-hour expressions while still rejecting ambiguous 밤 N시.
core/notebook_query_planning.py: preserve requested canonical Saju section labels in the expert prompt and accept safe section aliases in delivery checks.
tests/test_notebook_query_planning.py: add stale-date override, 12-hour birth time, section-label, and section-alias regression tests.
